recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, low-key studio portrait of two figures against a dark, textured teal-blue background, featuring a primary subject in a red cable-knit sweater and a secondary subject slightly behind. The composition is anchored by bold, multi-colored typography at the top and a graphic logo in the bottom corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in red sweater provides the primary warm focal point against a cool dark background
Secondary subject is positioned slightly out of focus to create depth and narrative tension
Typography is stacked centrally at the top, transitioning from decorative script to heavy slab serif
A high-contrast white rectangular sticker element breaks the dark left-side negative space
coreInvariants: Red cable-knit texture as a central color anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is seated, centered, and occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame; secondary subject is positioned behind the left shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red sweater of the foreground figure acts as the chromatic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the white script title, moves down to the red name, then follows the subject's gaze and hand position toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark space on the right side balances the subjects and the sticker element on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal and charcoal black (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Crimson red (primary subject's clothing and secondary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and yellow (metadata text and corner logo)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text/sticker and the dark background; high saturation in the red sweater against muted surroundings.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a 1960s palette of teal, red, and mustard yellow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of decorative cursive and heavy geometric slab serif
letterConstructionRules: Title uses high-contrast, ball-terminal script with heavy thicks and thin connectors
Artist name uses a heavy, rounded slab serif with thick strokes and minimal contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'f' and 'S' in the script have exaggerated, looping flourishes
The slab serif characters feature slightly rounded corners to soften the weight
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for elegance paired with a heavy slab for impact and name recognition.
graphicDevices: White rectangular 'hype sticker' with condensed sans-serif text
Circular corner logo with radiating lines and bird-like motif

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded slab-serif aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a red cable-knit sweater and a woman behind him, low-key lighting, dark teal textured wall background, grainy film texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a centered title in white decorative script at the top. Below it, add a larger name in heavy coral-red slab-serif. Place a small white rectangle with black text on the center-left.

verificationChecks: Is the red sweater the brightest part of the image?
Is the background a dark, moody teal?
Are there two distinct font styles in the header?

adjustableVariables: Placement of the white sticker element
mustRedesign: The exact brand logo in the bottom left
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script font has ball terminals
Verify the cable-knit texture is visible
Confirm the background is textured, not a flat color
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key studio portrait + Red focal point + Teal background + Script/Slab typographic stack
